before.title: StreamYard vs LiveKit for virtual events | West Peek Productions
before.description: StreamYard is better understood as a broadcast control layer for switching, overlays, and public streams; LiveKit is better understood as realtime venue infrastructure for interactive event rooms and custom attendee experiences.
